name: B10-0358/2025 (Renew) – Governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the United Nations to renew the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum permanently. This forum is a place where governments, companies and civil society discuss how the internet is run. Its current mandate runs out on 31 December 2025, and the UN General Assembly will review it in autumn 2025. The Parliament also wants the forum to get more resources and to keep its model where many different groups have a say, not just governments.

- Nothing changes yet: Parliament only states its position and calls for action.
- It affects the UN, EU countries, the Commission and internet users worldwide.
- Next: the UN General Assembly reviews the forum's mandate by the end of 2025.
